name: mediasense.plan.work
description: Save optional notes, preferences and one draft or complete candidate in revisioned Plan Work; deliver its collapsible group preview, retain complete bounded content reads, and seal exact revision-bound Human-confirmed content after page and same-revision conversational review.

working_notes.description: Agent-authored work summary. Omit to preserve; supply a string to replace, including an empty string to clear. This is not verified evidence, material retention, or Human confirmation.

organization_content.description: Omit to preserve; null clears the current organization and its identity; an object replaces the one current organization. Draft kind permits unassigned scope, candidate kind requires complete validation.

trusted_confirmation.description: Trusted transport context only. This definition is not a property accepted by an ordinary Work request.

reserved_plan_ref.description: The Work's preallocated Plan reference. An open Work has only a reservation; after seal this equals the published plan_ref. The value alone does not prove publication.

view.description: Per-invocation derived delivery observation, not part of the immutable operation receipt or Human authority. Revision is the requested snapshot, current_revision is the observed current Work revision.
